title: Preserve owner-approved behavior through branch alignment and handoff
trigger: rebase merge restoration concurrent branch regression rails return stairs cabinet textures working tree committed pushed
guidance: Before aligning an in-flight base, record the owned branch/HEAD, dirty scope and owner-corrected behaviors as a semantic checklist. Preserve existing fixes such as removed rails, floor-textured treads, closed headers/corners and view-switch texture survival while combining restored gameplay. Conflict resolution must be followed by those actual visual/behavioral checks; a conflict-free tree alone does not establish parity. Stay in the assigned isolated worktree and inspect peers read-only. At a requested hold/handoff, commit and verify the remote head and clean tracked tree; distinguish locally retained generated packs from tracked adapters, selection pins and reproduction steps. Defer new gameplay work while the owner asks to wait for a concurrent generator change.

evidence.reference: codex-thread:01a16a2c-da7b-7042-9108-3dbbc26da0f6; owner restoration-base alignment, returned-rails regression and commit/hold requests
evidence.note: Owner observed previous stair repairs regress while base work was being reconciled, and later requested all work committed/available while generator work continued elsewhere.
Recorded restoration integration, semantic stair gates and reproducible ignored asset packs. This is a recovery method; the historical handoff pin is not the current generator head.

recheck: Refresh the actual owner instruction, target base/branch, worktree custody, asset pins and current acceptance checklist. Rebase/merge or messaging authority is task-specific; a lesson or peer handoff grants none.
